definitions.short: a yoke (properly, for plowing), i.e. the frame of a loom
definitions.full: H4500. manor [ מָנוֺר ] noun masculine beam (probably round) carrying the heddles (in loom), = Latin jugum , so GFM l.c .; — only construct in phrase אֹרְגִים כִּמְנוֺר beam of weavers 1Sam 17:7 ; 2Sam 21:19 = 1Chr 20:5 ; 11:23 , all simile of thick and heavy shaft of spear.
